name: PI-Desktop
description: Local-first AI coding agent desktop: Electron + Rust host core + pi Agent Harness + user-installable plugins
one_liner: A desktop app that gives AI coding agents their own dedicated workspace — projects, chats, file reviews, and plugins all in one place — instead of living inside a terminal or editor plugin.
buyer: A freelance developer or small dev team managing several client projects with AI agents who wants one organized workspace instead of juggling terminals, editors, and browser tabs.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer manages multiple client codebases and long-running AI agent sessions from one desktop workspace, billing hours saved on context-switching.
A small dev agency standardizes on it internally, building custom plugins (panels, tools) tailored to their delivery process.
A plugin developer builds and sells premium extensions (custom review workflows, industry-specific tools) into its plugin ecosystem.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'teams' tier with shared session history, permissions, and audit logs for agencies managing multiple client agents.
Run a plugin marketplace and take a cut of paid third-party plugin sales.

steal_this: Build and sell one high-value plugin for it this weekend — e.g. a client-billing time tracker that logs agent session time per project.
